ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 80% of visible pixels occupy high-intensity white/light-grey values, with 20% occupying low-intensity black/dark-grey values concentrated at the perimeter and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white zones across both lobes; bounded by a thick, irregular low-intensity black margin along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; a distinct dark vertical rectangular cluster is positioned at the central base of the fluke below the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; approximately 85-degree internal angle; notch depth occupies approximately 12% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the trailing edge; higher frequency of small-amplitude 'peaks' and 'valleys' (approx. 2-5 pixel depth) on the inner sections of both lobes; edges become smoother toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to upward-tapering distal tips.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark pigmentation band extending vertically from the median notch toward the submerged peduncle area.
